notes.title: 'Stop the tyrannical overlord' 8.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Brownie's Adventure 8.0*Old version still accessible via 'beta' branch for people in mid play through

Thanks to feedback from brave and intrepid explorers across the globe I can bring you the '8.0' update.    I even removed the 'go faster stripes' from the edge of a couple of screens.   Ray tracing is now disabled by default. 

Escape now accesses save/options

F1 switches windowed/full screen

fixed glitch with Steve the frog

Ants no longer use AGS plugin for movement and have drawn animation sequences with

less irritating movement patterns.

Removed unwanted dialogue on WPC barmaid before key event

Added randomised footstep sounds to Brownie

Dialogue GUI now doesn't occupy the BG image as much and utilizies space better

Added UI sounds for gaining items

Added new title screen BG

Added UI clicks

Added new inventory item sprites with better clickability

Closed down potential bug in end conflict

Added some missing respones on inventory uses/hotspots

Touched up and fixed Grundolph's shop BG

Touched up and fixed Grottenberg City Entrance BG

Fixed Swamp BG

A few text colours changed for clarity

Fixed Firanygre's idle animation on court scene

Fixed a puzzle to be more cohesive in Act 3

Created new Intro/help Information and assets

Lots of small things... almost a Blink 182 song

notes.notes:
7.2 & Treasure Hunt

- Added THREE secret pass phrases (one per player) that if uttered in discord could reveal fame and fortune!

* Name in the readme as a TRUE adventurer!

Finders keepers - will remove once ALL treasures have been reported.

Bugs/Fixes:

- Fixed magic door interactions
- New response for Ford Mondeo distributor cap interactions
- Fixed 'use on' pegs interactions
- Respones for using items in Grundolph's toilet Act 3 
- Slightly increased size of hotspots for kebabylon 5 missing delivery puzzle
- Gui hidden in Act 3 final bomb scene
- Added crossfade for audio tracks
- Interactions for discarded disguise
- Enlarged hotspot for jungle trail
- Fixed lots of little things (please let me know via discord if you discover a bug!)
